Park Entry Permit A valid Park Entry Permit is required in all Saskatchewan Provincial Parks. Service Fee Day $11 Week $42 Annual $82 Senior Saskatchewan residents 65 or older (or turning 65 years of age anytime during the current year) can receive free daily, weekly or annual park entry. Government issued ID is required for proof of eligibility. Available in park only. Limit of one Senior Annual Entry permit per person. Traditional Resource Use First Nations, Métis, and Inuit individuals exercising their rights to carry out traditional use activities can receive a fee exempt daily, weekly or annual park entry permit upon arrival at the park by presenting a valid Certificate of Indian or Métis Status. Available in-park only. Limit of one Traditional Resource Use Annual Entry permit per person. Accessible 25% off daily, weekly and annual entry permits for visitors with a valid SaskAbilities accessible parking permit. Available in park only. Canoo Permanent Residents of Canada within their first 5 years of receiving permanent residence status, or new Canadian Citizens in the first 12 months of citizenship can receive a fee exempt daily entry permit with proof of Canoo membership. Eligible individuals are encouraged to download the Canoo app prior to their provincial park visit. There is a $1 shipping fee for annual permits purchased online and through the call centre. Annual permits purchased online and through the call centre cannot be picked up in-park. Once purchased, annual permits and associated shipping fees are non-refundable. Individuals may receive one fee exempt or discounted annual entry permit per camping season including Senior Annual Entry Permit, Traditional Resource Use Annual Entry Permit and Accessible Annual Entry Permit (if eligible).
